purpose: Discover, retrieve, validate and route high-value clinical, biomedical, hospital-research, medication, imaging, pathology, genomics and healthcare evidence. This branch is one additive branch of the Intelligence Center.

routing_policy.rule: Refer to downstream generic capabilities; never rename or convert another center into a hospital center.

live_or_existing_intelligence_sources.role: clinical trial search and study metadata
PubMed, PMC, Gene, Protein, ClinVar and other NCBI databases
FDA drugs, devices, food and regulatory open data
multi-source biomedical evidence MCP; local/external MCP runtime required

hospital_and_research_dataset_sources.role: clinical signals, ICU and hospital research datasets

hospital_and_research_dataset_sources.institution: Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center / MIT ecosystem
Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center / PhysioNet

hospital_and_research_dataset_sources.role: de-identified cancer radiology and pathology imaging
cancer genomics and clinical research data
large-scale biomedical cohort; reference/discovery only unless authorized

biomedical_evidence_mcp_and_api.role: unified biomedical evidence queries across trusted sources

medical_imaging_ai_and_processing.role: medical image registration, resampling and processing
CT/MR anatomical segmentation; task/license restrictions respected
chest X-ray datasets and pretrained research models
medical image visualization, registration, segmentation and analysis

pacs_dicom_and_web_viewing.role: web DICOM/DICOMweb viewer and imaging application framework
browser medical image rendering and annotation
lightweight DICOM/PACS server with REST API

digital_pathology.role: digital pathology and whole-slide bioimage analysis

clinical_data_and_interoperability.role: observational health data common model and analytics

de-identified hospital and ICU data research

top_hospital_open_research_anchors.anchor: Stanford Medicine / CheXpert and imaging AI research
Mayo Clinic, MSKCC, Stanford, NIH and other MONAI contributors
top_hospital_open_research_anchors.value: clinical/research participation in medical-imaging AI ecosystem

safety_and_access_rules: Public or properly authorized data only; never bypass hospital, dataset, IRB, credential, data-use or patient-consent restrictions.
Patient-identifiable records and images never enter GitHub.
Cataloged research software is not automatically a cleared medical device and is not automatically production-ready for patient care.
A tool marked catalog-downstream is discovered and registered but not claimed installed or live.
A downstream compute tool must pass runtime import/model-weight/license validation before execution.
The medical branch remains one Intelligence Center subdomain and does not redefine the center root identity.
